_note: TE (the town in the bowl's fifth phase): the ravine past its gate. crates/core/src/fox.rs reads this file, compiled in: these are rules, not presentation. Places are millimetres in the gate's own frame: across the pass from its middle (x) and along it away from the town (z), as ravine.rs gives the cliffs; ticks are 1/60 s

foxes._homes_mm: TE2 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-24: 'on the first ledge behind it two rabid foxes dodge every cut until one is slowed'): two foxes on the pass's floor 14 and 18 m behind the gate, either side of its middle, where the drop from the wing walls lands (the pass is 17 m across between the cliffs, ravine.rs's CLIFF_IN_MM)
foxes._pace_cm: unwary, each paces a ring this far round its home
foxes._sense_cm: within sense_cm of the player a fox turns and runs at them; past leave_cm from both homes, or with the player down, the living go home whole
foxes._lunge: within near_cm and arc_deg of its front it crouches (crouch_ticks, the warning), then leaps at lunge_cms for lunge_ticks, stopping a body's width (body_r_cm each) short of the player; halfway through, a player within reach_cm and arc_deg of its front is bitten: hurt and a stagger, unless the raised shield covers that side
foxes._recover: after a leap it backs off at back_cms for recover_ticks, then runs in again
foxes._dodge: a cut that would meet a fox that is not slowed meets nothing: it hops dodge_cm aside, away from the blade, over dodge_ticks, and no cut reaches it while it hops. Slowed by the orb (spell.rs's slow_ticks, at slow_pct of its speed) it cannot
foxes._hits: a slowed fox's cut is a hit, one each hit_wait ticks; hits kill it

gate._windlass_mm: TE3 (R9.585: the bar stays on the town's side; a windlass on the ravine side lifts it, so it is lifted from inside the pass): the windlass stands on the pass's floor behind the left tower (the tower runs to 2.2 m along the pass), clear of the leaves' swing (to 2.4 m) and the foxes' homes
gate._use_cm: E turns it from within use_cm of its middle (and story.rs's reach), the feet within over_cm of the ground it stands on, so not from the wing wall's walk above; only once the foxes are beaten
gate._lift_ticks: turned, the bar rises over lift_ticks, then the leaves swing open into the pass over swing_ticks; the leaves keep a body out until they are open
